::: {.lead}
Lecturer in Information Systems at Telkom University and PhD candidate at the University of Western Australia. I combine more than fifteen years of experience in university teaching, learning technology leadership and IT consulting. My research applies learning analytics, data mining and process mining to understand and support students' self-regulated learning in online and collaborative environments.
:::

## Industry experience

::: {.cv-entry}
[2009--2013]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
**Senior IT Consultant & Solution Architect**\
PT Totalindo Rekayasa Telematika, Jakarta

Designed and delivered business-process, technology-infrastructure and IT-governance strategies for public- and private-sector clients. Key projects:

- **Ministry of Home Affairs, e-KTP national ID programme (2011--2012):** designed the helpdesk business processes and led the agile customisation, rollout and agent training of the helpdesk management system.
- **PUSLIA, West Java Regional Revenue Office (2012--2013):** designed IT service standard operating procedures and implemented an open-source ticketing system.
- **Perum Bulog (2011--2012):** developed the IT/IS blueprint and roadmap, then led the ERP initiation: requirements, technical specification, cost and schedule estimates, and terms of reference.
- **Baitul Maal Hidayatullah (2010--2011):** led the implementation of an open-source ERP system.
:::
:::

## Research experience

::: {.cv-entry}
[2016--2018]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
**Enterprise Data Management Lab, Telkom University**

- Analysed how GRIT, self-efficacy and gamification relate to student performance in blended learning (2017--2018).
- Applied Apriori association rules to web-usage logs and GRIT scores to identify factors that determine student outcomes.
- Built a Pentaho ETL pipeline for two million rows of student data, leading to the paper *Soft Set Approach for Clustering Graduated Dataset* (Springer, 2017).
:::
:::

## Publications

Twenty-four publications since 2013, in venues including *Sustainability*, *Journal of Computers*, Springer and IEEE conferences, and ASCILITE. Selected work:

- Hasibuan, M. A., Reynolds, M., Male, S., & Hassan, G. M. (2023). Role of theory in analysing the dynamic of self-regulated learning process based on students' event logs data: A scoping review. *ASCILITE 2023: People, Partnerships and Pedagogies*, 126--136.
- Hasibuan, M. A., Andreswari, R., Lubis, M., Perdana, F., & Fakhrurroja, H. (2023). Classification algorithm for predicting the graduation level: Case study of e-learning in Telkom University. In *Intelligent Sustainable Systems* (Vol. 1). Springer.
- Lubis, M., Hasibuan, M. A., & Andreswari, R. (2022). Satisfaction measurement in the blended learning system of the university: The Literacy Mediated-Discourses (LM-D) framework. *Sustainability*, 14(19), 12929.
- Hasibuan, M. A., Reynolds, M., Male, S., Hassan, G. M., & Kusumasari, T. F. (2021). Assessing a measurement model of self-regulated learning in an online collaborative learning environment. *REES AAEE 2021 Conference*.
- Putri, D. Y., Andreswari, R., & Hasibuan, M. A. (2018). Analysis of students graduation target based on academic data record using C4.5 algorithm. Case study: Information Systems students of Telkom University. *6th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)*, 1--6. IEEE.
- Dwiandriani, F., Kusumasari, T. F., & Hasibuan, M. A. (2017). Fingerprint clustering algorithm for data profiling using Pentaho Data Integration. *2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Information Systems and Electrical Engineering (ICITISEE)*, 359--363. IEEE.
- Saedudin, R. R., Kasim, S. B., Mahdin, H., & Hasibuan, M. A. (2017). Soft set approach for clustering graduated dataset. In *Recent Advances on Soft Computing and Data Mining* (pp. 631--637). Springer.
- Hidayanto, A. N., Hasibuan, M. A., Handayani, P. W., & Sucahyo, Y. G. (2013). Framework for measuring ERP implementation readiness in small and medium enterprise (SME): A case study in software developer company. *Journal of Computers*, 8(7), 1777--1782.

[Full publication list →](https://muhammadazani.github.io/publications.html)
